0.00209: Review after the phone work: the shrine, treasure and title panels now get the phone's compact layout (a desktop rule used to win), the hall keeps clear of the notch, XP and coins are readable, the boons sit on top of the knight's card, and FULLSCREEN leaves the phone's menu — PLAY is the way in
A phone's first tap starts the music and the narrator's welcome (a touch counts at the tap's end); PLAY is a proper dialog and INSTALL works more than once
The 3D background draws at no more than 2x pixel density on sharp phone screens (cooler, smoother)
Export Save and Import Save open as dialogs; the Great Hall's dot on EQUIPMENT lights when something can be forged (it used to light ALCHEMY)

Fixes: a failed load says so and a tap retries; a room change on a flat background waits for the painting; music muted during its first load stays silent; a rare freeze after an effect error; the equipment rows' styles

0.00206: Low on health with no potion left, Retreat with Loot pulses red after a cleared room and Push Deeper stays plain (drink one and it flips back)
